title: Analyses
description: What the trades say: who moves first (decision note 0020).

panels.title: Who moved first
panels.description: Moves of more than the base's threshold within a second (BTC 5, ETH 7, SOL 9 bps), paired across the exchanges when they go the same way within 2 s. Times are each exchange's own, so a difference between their clocks would look like a lead; and the less active market shows a move only at its next trade.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT base AS "Base",
       countIf(lead_us IS NOT NULL) AS "Pairs",
       round(100 * countIf(lead_us > 0 AND leader = 'BINANCE')
             / nullIf(countIf(lead_us IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "Binance first (%)",
       round(100 * countIf(lead_us > 0 AND leader = 'KRAKEN')
             / nullIf(countIf(lead_us IS NOT NULL), 0), 1) AS "Kraken first (%)",
       countIf(lead_us = 0) AS "Ties",
       round(medianExactIf(lead_us, lead_us > 0 AND leader = 'BINANCE') / 1000)
           AS "Median lead, Binance first (ms)",
       round(medianExactIf(lead_us, lead_us > 0 AND leader = 'KRAKEN') / 1000)
           AS "Median lead, Kraken first (ms)",
       countIf(lead_us IS NULL AND leader = 'BINANCE') AS "Binance moves not followed",
       countIf(lead_us IS NULL AND leader = 'KRAKEN') AS "Kraken moves not followed"
FROM ticklab.lead_lag FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(leader_time)
GROUP BY base
ORDER BY base

panels.title: How long the second exchange took
panels.description: Pairs by how much later the other exchange's move came, by the exchange that moved first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT base AS "Base", leader AS "First",
       countIf(lead_us <= 50000) AS "up to 50 ms",
       countIf(lead_us > 50000 AND lead_us <= 100000) AS "50-100 ms",
       countIf(lead_us > 100000 AND lead_us <= 250000) AS "100-250 ms",
       countIf(lead_us > 250000 AND lead_us <= 500000) AS "250-500 ms",
       countIf(lead_us > 500000 AND lead_us <= 1000000) AS "0.5-1 s",
       countIf(lead_us > 1000000) AS "1-2 s"
FROM ticklab.lead_lag FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(leader_time) AND lead_us > 0
GROUP BY base, leader
ORDER BY base, leader

panels.title: Latest moves
panels.description: Newest first. A move with no lead was not followed by the other exchange within 2 s.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT leader_time AS "First move", base AS "Base", direction AS "Direction",
       leader AS "First", round(lead_us / 1000, 1) AS "Lead (ms)",
       round(leader_bps, 2) AS "First move (bps)", round(follower_bps, 2) AS "Second move (bps)"
FROM ticklab.lead_lag FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(leader_time)
ORDER BY leader_time DESC
LIMIT 50
